title: Week 2: dplyr
text:
Key Concepts

dplyr: R package that is used for cleaning, transforming, and manipulating data. It is part of the tidyverse ecosystem.
filter -> rows vs. select -> columns: This can easily be remembered because filte(r) and sele(c)t.
THE PIPE: The pipe allows us to write several operations in a row with minimal text and objects. It can be thought of as “and then”.
data shapes, long vs. wide: If output = wide, two series are places side by side which allows for easier comparison.

title: Week 2: dplyr
text:
Reflection

After Friday’s class, I think that I am much faster at typing code. I am starting to pick up on the functions of different punctuation in R, I can begin to predict what a command will do, and what errors may arise. Furthermore, between this class and my python class, I am beginning to understand/recognize how the same functions are written differently across various coding languages.
